rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for things that are alike or comparable in everyday situations.

example.english: The functions of these two phones are similar.
example.traditional: 呢兩款手機嘅功能差唔多。
example.jyutping: nei1 loeng5 fun2 sau2 gei1 ge3 gung1 nang4 caa1 m4 do1

rows.note: Speakers use this formal technical term for mathematically similar shapes.

example.jyutping: nei1 loeng5 go3 saam1 gok3 jing4 soeng1 ci5
